create_activation_ckpt_wrapper: create an activation checkpointing wrapper for a PyTorch module to reduce memory usage during training
enable_activation_checkpointing: enable activation checkpointing on a PyTorch module by wrapping it with act_ckpt_enable=True
disable_activation_checkpointing: disable activation checkpointing on a wrapped module by passing act_ckpt_enable=False
create_clone_output_wrapper: create a clone output wrapper for a function to clone CUDA tensors and prevent in-place operation errors
prevent_inplace_errors: prevent in-place operation errors with torch.compile by wrapping functions with clone_output_wrapper
